body:
An Agent button now opens a chat backed by Claude Code or Codex, in c2fa5a0 to 7d4f115 and running in the existing HTTPS app. A message such as "zrobiłem 10 pompek" is applied by the agent through projectctl, and the dialog shows only the message and the final answer. The provider is chosen in Settings; the agent's instructions are agent/AGENTS.md.

The host runs the agent only when started with --agent-dir (ASTRA_TRY_AGENT=1 for the manual app), with full access and no permission prompts by the owner's direction. Conversations live in memory and end with a daemon restart. No physical phone was used. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-agent-chat.md; decision: docs/ADR-070-AGENT-RUNS.md.

metadata.summary: In-app agent with Claude Code or Codex
